decks.notes: The deck focuses on aggressive, fast-paced gameplay using low cost creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It prioritizes controlling the board and maintaining pressure through constant threats. With a mix of direct damage and creature aggression, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Monstrous Rage and Reckless Rage allows for additional reach and removal capabilities to push for a victory. The mana base is streamlined to ensure consistent plays and maximize efficiency in executing the game plan.

The main idea of this Izzet Control deck is to utilize a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and card draw to control the game and disrupt your opponent's strategy. By using cards like Spell Pierce, Torch the Tower, and Boomerang Basics, you can slow down your opponent's progress while advancing your own game plan with cards like Ral, Crackling Wit and Igneous Inspiration. With a mix of control elements and card advantage engines, this deck aims to outsmart and outlast your opponent in a game of wits and strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures while quickly building up devotion to green for powerful cards like Craterhoof Behemoth and Boseiju, Who Endures. The deck utilizes mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to ramp up to bigger threats, while also including cards like Nature's Rhythm to ensure a steady stream of mana. By focusing on a green devotion strategy and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to quickly establish board control and secure a victory before the opponent can respond.

This aggressive white deck focuses on playing small creatures quickly to overwhelm opponents with a swarm of creatures. By utilizing cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, Thalia's Lieutenant, and Kytheon, Hero of Akros, the deck aims to go wide and buff its creatures to deal massive damage to the opponent. Mutavault provides additional creature options, while Declaration in Stone can deal with opposing threats. Castle Ardenvale and Giant Killer offer additional utility and control options to further support the aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a combination of removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, along with creature disruption from cards like Nowhere to Run and Stormchaser's Talent. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the deck, while cards like Cryogen Relic and Thundertrap Trainer help stall the game until the player can establish their control. The deck also includes a mix of lands to ensure smooth mana development and consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on creating a powerful combo with Greasefang and Parhelion II to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. It includes cards for controlling the board with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also providing ramp and card advantage with Cache Grab and Formidable Speaker. The deck also includes a mix of lands to support the color requirements of the cards in the deck. Overall, the key strategy is to set up the combo pieces and out value the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through removal spells and hand disruption while also utilizing creatures and planeswalkers to maintain board presence. The deck utilizes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay to deal with threats, along with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize. Additionally, the deck includes powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser to pressure the opponent. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells. This deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win through control and attrition.

This deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent through efficient creature spells and burn spells. With cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, the deck aims to apply early pressure and finish off the opponent with spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage. The deck also includes card draw and mana fixing to ensure consistency in the aggro strategy. By exploiting the synergy between creatures and spells, this deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively cast spells to quickly bring out Arclight Phoenix and overwhelm the opponent with a continuous stream of damage. The deck focuses on efficient card draw and cheap spells to help trigger the Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard. The inclusion of Picklock Prankster and Artist's Talent adds versatility to the deck, allowing for disruption and additional damage. The mana base is set up to support the deck's tempo and casting requirements, ensuring a relentless assault on the opponent.

The core theme of the deck is to utilize the synergy between Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful combo. The deck contains various support cards such as Bitter Triumph, Cache Grab, Multiversal Passage, and Formidable Speaker to enable the combo. Additionally, there are cards like Esika's Chariot and Thundering Broodwagon for additional threats and Professor of Symbology for card advantage. The mana base includes both lands that produce colored mana and lands that help with the combo like Boseiju, Who Endures. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces for a game-winning finish.

This deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo, utilizing cards like Monument to Endurance and Fleeting Spirit to protect key pieces. The strategy involves disrupting the opponent with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push while ramping up mana with The Mycosynth Gardens and Bleachbone Verge. Once the combo is in place, the deck can create a powerful board presence with Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II. The key is to maintain board control and tempo until the combo can be assembled and executed for a game-winning play.

This mono black control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through hand disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, and powerful threats like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. It also aims to gain advantage in the late game with cards like The Meathook Massacre and Graveyard Trespasser. The deck utilizes various ways to control the game state and outvalue opponents to secure a victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through removal spells like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Abrupt Decay while also utilizing creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Sentinel of the Nameless City to provide pressure on the opponent. The deck also aims to generate advantage with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Emeritus of Abundance. The inclusion of cards like Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber and Tear Asunder allow for flexibility in dealing with different threats, making it a versatile and adaptable Control deck.

The deck focuses on using a combination of cards to quickly generate value and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Greasefang and Parhelion II. It includes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Bitter Triumph to control the board and protect the combo pieces. The deck also utilizes cards like Cache Grab and Multiversal Passage to ensure consistency and access to mana. Overall, the strategy revolves around setting up a strong board presence and leveraging the synergy between the various components to outpace and outmatch the opponent.

The key idea behind this deck is to aggressively control the board and tempo of the game by utilizing low-cost, efficient spells and creatures. The deck aims to apply pressure early on with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, while also using burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to clear the way for attacks. The inclusion of cards like Academic Dispute and Stormchaser's Talent provide additional card advantage and versatility. By combining aggressive creatures with powerful instant spells, the deck seeks to overwhelm opponents and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on using control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan while utilizing powerful creatures and spells to gradually gain advantage and overwhelm the opponent. It combines removal spells like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay with powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Professor Dellian Fel to control the board and pressure the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Graveyard Trespasser to disrupt the opponent's strategy. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast its opponent in a grindy game.
